title: U.S. House, District 26
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 26th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from CBS Miami primary coverage and local (Coral Springs/Miramar/Pembroke Pines News) reporting: Mario Diaz-Balart (R) and Nicole Locklin (D) were each unopposed in their primaries; Deborah Meidinger Hosey (NPA) is also on the November ballot. County makeup under the new map was not confirmed beyond Miami-Dade. Sources: https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/live-updates/2026-florida-primary-live-updates-results/ ; https://www.coralspringsflnews.com/news/local/article316927284.html ; https://locklinforcongress.com/ Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.name: Mario Diaz-Balart
candidates.photo_source: congress.gov member portrait (bioguide ID from memory, unverified)
candidates.background: Mario Diaz-Balart has served in the U.S. House since 2003 and previously served in the Florida Legislature. He chairs the House Appropriations subcommittee on National Security, Department of State and Related Programs. He was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary for the 26th District. Local coverage describes the redrawn district as including southwest Broward communities such as Miramar and Pembroke Pines.
candidates.primary_result: Unopposed in Aug 18, 2026 Republican primary (CBS Miami)

taxes.summary: Diaz-Balart voted for H.R. 1 (2025) and said it 'responsibly reduces excess spending' while making the 2017 tax cuts permanent, which he said averted a 24% tax hike for the average FL-26 taxpayer.

candidates.name: Nicole Locklin
candidates.occupation: Attorney (most recently lead commercial legal counsel for health care and life sciences at Databricks)
candidates.background: Nicole Locklin is a Miami-based attorney with more than a decade of experience in law, compliance and business operations, including work at Nextdoor beginning in 2020 and most recently as lead commercial legal counsel for health care and life sciences at Databricks. Local coverage says she is originally from Oklahoma and has lived in Miami since 2024. She was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary. Her campaign centers on affordability, anti-corruption (she pledges to reject corporate PAC money), universal health care, ending immigration raids and ending 'endless wars.'
candidates.primary_result: Unopposed in Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary (CBS Miami)

taxes.summary: Locklin advocates higher taxes on billionaires and large corporations to fund investments in health care, housing, education and jobs.
